preconditions.description: k is a non-negative integer bounded by 10,000
m is a positive integer bounded by 300,000

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == 8 and line.isdigit() for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is exactly 8 digits long
All m output tickets are distinct

postconditions.expression: all(any(eval(expr) == k for expr in generate_expressions(line)) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output ticket is k-lucky, meaning there exists at least one valid arithmetic expression formed by inserting +, -, ×, and brackets between its digits that evaluates to k
